scope: literature analysis and public-database interfaces for reaction entities, source-qualified energy, and catalyst geometry

evidence.title: Catalysis-Hub.Org; CatHub Tutorial; Catalysis-Hub GraphQL
evidence.support: Official material exposes reactants, products, reaction_energy, facet, reaction_id and optional ASE atom records. The service describes periodic plane-wave DFT reaction energies and some optimized geometries.
evidence.live_receipt: GET GraphQL interface 200; unauthenticated POST 401 Missing API key; login page 200 and ties a free key to ORCID.
evidence.limitations: reaction_energy can be adsorption energy; records can differ in functional and reference state; not every record has geometry; no cross-record performance ranking is justified. A data-record licence must be checked per publication.

evidence.title: Open Catalyst 2020 (OC20)
evidence.support: S2EF provides structures, energies and forces; IS2RS/IS2RE provide initial and relaxed structures and relaxed energies. Mapping fields include bulk_mpid, Miller index and adsorption-site coordinates.
evidence.live_receipt: Official GitHub documentation 200; a dataset-document link from the project site returned 404, so the repository document is the recorded fallback.
evidence.limitations: OC20 is distributed as large archives rather than a light query API. It does not encode the complete CO2 plus H2 to ethanol reaction network, and adsorption or relaxed-structure energies are not experimental catalyst performance. Data are CC-BY-4.0; software is MIT.

evidence.title: Materials Project API and structure schema
evidence.support: The schema exposes material identifiers, bulk structure, formation and hull-related energies, lattice and site coordinates. structure is the lowest-energy bulk structure.
evidence.live_receipt: OpenAPI 200; unauthenticated materials summary request 401; the regular API requires X-API-KEY and limits a request to 1000 records.
evidence.limitations: Bulk structure is not an adsorbate-active-site interface. equilibrium_reaction_energy_per_atom is a hull quantity, not the arbitrary user reaction energy. The separate anonymous OPTIMADE snapshot mp-19306 is used only as an Fe3O4 support record.

evidence.title: Crossref REST API
evidence.support: The open REST service returns deposited DOI metadata including title, authors, dates, publisher and landing links.
evidence.live_receipt: The target ACS DOI endpoint returned 200. The record has no abstract; automated access to the publisher page was 403.
evidence.limitations: Metadata and a PDF link do not grant full-text access or redistribution rights. Crossref supplies neither reaction energy nor geometry, and citation counts are dynamic metadata rather than scientific evidence.

evidence.title: OpenAlex Works API and Work attributes
evidence.support: A Work can expose DOI, authorships, locations, open-access state and an abstract inverted index. OpenAlex metadata are CC0.
evidence.live_receipt: The target DOI returned 200 with primary DOI landing page, closed OA status, pdf_url null, best_oa_location null and has_fulltext false.
evidence.limitations: An abstract index is not full text; topics are algorithmic labels. OpenAlex metadata do not make closed publisher content open and contain no reaction-energy or catalyst-coordinate record.

evidence.title: alphaXiv MCP Server Documentation
evidence.support: The Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint offers paper discovery, content retrieval and page-qualified queries. get_paper_content defaults to an AI-generated intermediate report; fullText=true is required to request extracted original text.
evidence.live_receipt: Documentation 200; unauthenticated GET and POST to the MCP endpoint returned 401 Missing Authorization.
evidence.limitations: OAuth 2.1 or an API key is required. The AI intermediate report is not primary-source evidence; page filters can omit context; paper licences remain source-specific.

evidence.title: arXiv API Access and Terms of Use
evidence.support: The Atom response returns versioned arXiv identity, title, authors, abstract, dates, categories and canonical links. Descriptive metadata are CC0.
evidence.live_receipt: The id_list request returned 200 with version v3 and canonical abstract and PDF links.
evidence.limitations: The legacy API rate rule is one request per three seconds across the machine. Individual e-print licences differ, and a preprint is not automatically a peer-reviewed conclusion.

global_boundary: These energy kinds must not be collapsed onto one ranking axis. @best orders matching records by retrieval relevance and data completeness only.
